reporting-org.narrative:
TRIAL International is a non-governmental organization fighting impunity for international crimes and supporting victims in their quest for justice.
TRIAL International takes an innovative approach to the law, paving the way to justice for survivors of unspeakable sufferings. The organization provides legal assistance, litigates cases, develops local capacity and pushes the human rights agenda forward.

title.narrative: Fighting Against Impunity and Promoting Transitional Justice in the Democratic Republic of Congo

description.narrative: The activity aims at fighting against impunity and promoting accountability and transitional justice in the Democratic Republic of the Congo – on the basis of the principle of complementarity established by the ICC Statute – by improving access to justice for victims of gross human rights violations, strengthening the capacities of Congolese actors to effectively document and prosecute these crimes, and supporting the design and implementation of adequate transitional justice mechanisms.

sector.narrative: This project aims at strenghtening the fight against impunity, the promotion of accountability, and transitional justice in the DRC

comment.narrative: TRIAL International's free legal training sessions for judicial actors were postponed to the first quarter of 2024. At the beginning of the reporting period, the organisation had an unforeseen opportunity to collaborate with the Conseil supérieur de la magistrature (CSM) which is responsible for training newly recruited judges. As part of their initial three-month training, TRIAL International provided 2,500 new judges with a three-day course on the investigation and prosecution of international crimes.
